{{Top|leg}}
A '''tactician battle computer''' was a software package and transmitter that could be installed on any [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

==Characteristics==
The tactician battle [[Computer/Legends|computer]] was paired with a transceiver on a specific ranged [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]]. This prevented a droid from being able to attack using any available weapon. In fact, if the droid tried to use a non-matched weapon, the tactician battle computer would shut down completely.

In addition, the tactician battle computer allowed droids to share tactical data gathered from their [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] to other droids equipped with battle computers, increasing their accuracy.

==History==
The tactician battle computer was developed by droid manufactures to get around restrictions on 4th-degree droids.
